text: In 1462, Vlad Dracula comes home from war to find his wife Elisabeta dead by her own hand, and [renounces God over her damned soul|origin|grief that will not end]. Four centuries later the solicitor Jonathan Harker [travels to his Transylvanian castle|trigger|travelling somewhere remote], where the Count sees a picture of Jonathan's fiancée Mina and believes her [Elisabeta reborn|wants|getting back the lost]. Leaving Jonathan to his brides, Dracula sails for London with boxes of his native soil, bites Mina's friend Lucy, and courts Mina by daylight while Van Helsing [fights back with a communion wafer and a ring of fire|rules|faith and charms protect].
